# @agents-js/wake-signal-store

> Durable wake-signal store for the AJS-89 HYBRID gateway substrate. Source-side persistence + at-least-once delivery dedup for wake signals consumed by per-harness terminal adapters (e.g. @agents-js/claude-channel-adapter). Persistence-backend swap shape (in-mem → SQLite → Postgres) baked into the Backend interface.

## Installation

```sh
bun add @agents-js/wake-signal-store
```
